description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractBufferedRateExecutor' that manages buffered rate-limited execution of asynchronous tasks, including thread management, task dispatching, timeout handling, and logging, within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: AbstractBufferedRateExecutor
classes.description: An abstract class managing buffered, rate-limited execution of asynchronous tasks with thread management, timeout handling, and logging within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a task for execution, applying rate limiting per tenant, and returning a future result.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down all executor services used by the class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new future for task result.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Abstract method to wrap a task and its future into an AsyncTaskContext.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute a task asynchronously.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Main loop for dispatching tasks from the queue, managing concurrency, timeouts, and callbacks.

methods.name: logTask
methods.description: Logs details about task processing actions.

methods.name: queryToString
methods.description: Converts a Cassandra BoundStatement to its string representation with values.

methods.name: toStringWithValues
methods.description: Helper to generate a query string with actual parameter values for debugging.

methods.name: getQueueSize
methods.description: Returns current size of the task queue.

methods.name: printStats
methods.description: Prints current statistics about the executor, including queue size, rate limits, and tenant info.
